file_reviews.assessment: Audited Paper 010 Section 2.1 definitions (edge orientation inversion, plaquette boundary words, vertex gauge conjugation, and torus cycle loops), Section 2.2 check_flatness certificate rules, Section 2.4 unit-test claims (interior single-link defects, seam-pair flatness over S_3 and Q_8, orientation reversal, and basepoint shift), and Table 1 boundary single-link cases.

Audited LaTeX manuscript parity with paper.md across Sections 2.1, 2.2, and 2.4 covering plaquette orientation identities, gauge covariance W'_{r,c} = g_{v_0} W_{r,c} g_{v_0}^{-1}, single interior non-identity link coboundary counts, and the 3x4 S_3 x S_3 and Q_8 x Q_8 seam family.

Audited claim ledger rows PFP10-05 (plaquette orientation reversal and starting-vertex shift), PFP10-06 (gauge conjugation at the plaquette's first vertex), PFP10-10 (single interior non-identity link affecting two plaquettes), PFP10-12 (3x4 torus seam-pair flatness criterion and commutator), and related capstone row PFP10-47.

Audited FiniteGroup._check_axioms, symmetric_group_s3, quaternion_group_q8, Lattice (positive_edges, plaquette, loop_a, loop_b), Connection (link, path_holonomy, cycle_holonomy, plaquette_links, plaquette_holonomy), gauge_transform, _check_gauge, check_flatness, _plaquette_listings, and verify_claim.

Audited packet() reversed-certificate positive/negative check (lines 45-54), seam_family census over S_3 (18 commuting across 36 pairs) and Q_8 (40 commuting across 64 pairs) yielding 2 FLAT_TRIVIAL, 56 FLAT_NONTRIVIAL, and 42 NOT_FLAT outcomes (lines 56-75), and 4x5 Q_8 gauge-dependent skipping control (lines 77-84).

Audited Section 2 path-order convention notes (reversal inversion, basepoint shift conjugation, and Q_8 commutator plaquette -e = (-e)^{-1}) and Section 3 local flatness vs global torus gauge triviality notes.
Audited lattice gauge holonomy and principal-bundle flat-connection references cited by Paper 010 Section 2.

claims.statement: Under reversed-edge inversion U_{vu} = U_{uv}^{-1} in any group, reversing a plaquette's traversal order at its basepoint inverts its ordered product (W_rev = W^{-1}), shifting its starting vertex by k steps conjugates W by the prefix transport P_k = u_0...u_{k-1} (W^{(k)} = P_k^{-1} W P_k), and both S_3 and Q_8 admit plaquette products of order >= 3 satisfying W != W^{-1}.
dependencies: Group associativity, two-sided identity, and two-sided inverse anti-automorphism (xy)^{-1} = y^{-1} x^{-1} validated for finite multiplication tables by FiniteGroup._check_axioms in code/holonomy.py.
Directional edge inversion U_{vu} = U_{uv}^{-1} in Connection.link and left-folded ordered multiplication in Connection.cycle_holonomy across all eight dihedral listings in _plaquette_listings.

Order-3 elements ('120', '201') in symmetric_group_s3() and order-4 units ('i', '-i', 'j', '-j', 'k', '-k') in quaternion_group_q8() realizing W != W^{-1} on 432/1296 S_3 and 3072/4096 Q_8 open 2x2 connections as well as periodic lattices.
claims.limits: Complements PAPER010-WITNESS-ACCEPTANCE; reversal alters the plaquette element only when ord(W) >= 3 (order-2 elements such as transpositions in S_3 and '-e' in Q_8 satisfy W = W^{-1} != e), and FiniteGroup._check_axioms checks finite string-keyed tables dynamically in Python rather than in Lean 4.

claims.statement: Under a vertex gauge transformation U'_{uv} = g_u U_{uv} g_v^{-1} with U_{vu} = U_{uv}^{-1} in any group, intermediate vertex gauge factors cancel along each plaquette boundary so that W'_{r,c} = g_{v_0} W_{r,c} g_{v_0}^{-1} at the plaquette's first vertex v_0 = (r, c), preserving local flatness W_{r,c} = e iff W'_{r,c} = e.
dependencies: Compatibility of positive-edge gauge transformation U'_{uv} = g_u U_{uv} g_v^{-1} in gauge_transform with reversed-edge inversion U'_{vu} = (U'_{uv})^{-1} = g_v U_{vu} g_u^{-1} in Connection.link.

Total vertex gauge validation _check_gauge covering connection.lattice.vertices() and associative cancellation g_{v_m}^{-1} g_{v_m} = e along closed plaquette boundaries P_{r,c} based at v_0 = (r, c).

Open obligation: Agreement between the general group-theoretic law and code/holonomy.py is verified by source inspection and bounded finite-lattice execution over S_3 and Q_8 rather than formal verification.
claims.limits: Distinct from Rust matrix node RFA-CL023; conjugation preserves conjugacy class and flatness W_{r,c} = e iff W'_{r,c} = e rather than raw non-central plaquette elements, does not preserve skipped_identity_plaquettes, and checks code/holonomy.py on finite lattices only.

claims.statement: On any admissible open (L, M >= 2) or periodic (L, M >= 3) rectangular lattice over any group G, setting one non-boundary positive link to a != e and all remaining positive links to e yields NOT_FLAT with nonflat_plaquettes == 2 carrying products a and a^{-1}, whereas single open-boundary link defects affect 1 plaquette and periodic torus surface cancellation restricts any sole non-flat plaquette holonomy to [G, G].
dependencies: Admissible rectangular lattice dimensions enforced by Lattice.__post_init__ (L, M >= 2 for periodic=False; L, M >= 3 for periodic=True) so the two coboundary plaquettes incident to an interior edge have distinct origins.
Opposite-orientation edge-plaquette incidence in Lattice.plaquette assigning products a != e and a^{-1} != e to the two incident plaquettes and (e, e, e, e) -> e to all remaining plaquettes.
Closed-surface boundary telescoping on periodic tori forcing the abelianized product of all LM plaquette holonomies in G/[G, G] to equal the identity coset.
claims.limits: Complements PAPER010-RECTANGULAR-HOLONOMY-CLASSIFIER; open 2x2 grids have zero interior edges (open interior horizontal edges require L >= 3 and open interior vertical edges require M >= 3), and multi-link non-abelian torus connections can realize nonflat_plaquettes == 1 when the sole defect lies in [G, G] \ {e}.

claims.statement: For every pair (a, b) in S_3 x S_3 (36 pairs) and Q_8 x Q_8 (64 pairs) on the 3x4 periodic torus seam connection U^{(a,b)}, all 11 non-corner plaquettes evaluate to e and the corner plaquette P_{2,3} evaluates to b a b^{-1} a^{-1}, so U^{(a,b)} is flat iff ab = ba (18 in S_3^2, 40 in Q_8^2), with flat cycle products (a, b) simultaneously conjugated to (g_{(0,0)} a g_{(0,0)}^{-1}, g_{(0,0)} b g_{(0,0)}^{-1}) under any vertex gauge.
dependencies: Four-region plaquette partition on periodic L x M seam connections (L, M >= 3) cancelling single-seam links in opposite-orientation pairs a a^{-1} = e and b b^{-1} = e on all LM - 1 non-corner plaquettes while concentrating b a b^{-1} a^{-1} on P_{L-1, M-1}.
Common basepoint (0, 0) shared by Lattice.loop_a and Lattice.loop_b so closed-path gauge telescoping conjugates both cycle products by the single vertex element g_{(0,0)}.

Exhaustive evaluation across all 36 S_3 x S_3 and 64 Q_8 x Q_8 seam pairs matching Burnside conjugacy-class counts k(S_3)|S_3| = 18 and k(Q_8)|Q_8| = 40 (2 FLAT_TRIVIAL, 56 FLAT_NONTRIVIAL, and 42 NOT_FLAT).
claims.limits: Complements PAPER010-RECTANGULAR-HOLONOMY-CLASSIFIER; tests the |G|^2 seam subfamily (36 of 6^24 in S_3, 64 of 8^24 in Q_8) rather than all connections on the 3x4 torus, and simultaneous conjugation by one element relies on loop_a and loop_b sharing the common basepoint (0, 0).
